has_own_site_check.conclusion: No owned domain found anywhere. Every public presence is Booksy, Fresha, a directory/aggregator, an LLC filing record, or social media. has_own_site = false confirmed, consistent with task brief.

address.how_resolved: Fresha listing (self-fetched live) shows this exact address paired with telephone (863) 660-1188, which matches the already-verified phone number in the task brief exactly. Birdeye's unclaimed listing independently shows the same address. My Posh Suites (a salon-suite rental facility) lists its 'South Lakeland - Shepherd Rd' location's physical address as 6950 Appaloosa Drive, Lakeland, FL 33811, confirming MIM operates a rented private suite inside that facility.
address.discrepancy_note: Booksy's own JSON-LD (self-fetched live) and the Mim's Fade Room LLC filing's principal address both show a DIFFERENT address: 1631 Shepherd Road, Lakeland, FL 33811. That address has no phone attached anywhere and is most likely a stale/legacy Booksy listing address or the LLC's paperwork address rather than the current physical suite. Because the Appaloosa Dr address is the one independently corroborated by the already-verified phone number (task brief) across two sources (Fresha + Birdeye) plus the My Posh Suites facility match, it was used as the site's displayed physical address. This is disclosed here for transparency.

geo_note: No precise lat/lng independently confirmed for the Appaloosa Dr suite in this session; JSON-LD ships PostalAddress only (no GeoCoordinates) and the map embed uses an address-string query instead of coordinates, to avoid fabricating geo data.

images.curation_note: Strict visual curation, every one of the 28 downloaded files viewed individually before deciding. Booksy set: bk-1 (1285x722, real, usable: client in shop chair wearing a 'Mim The Barber' branded tee, real interior visible) and bk-3 (1300x1300, real but a heavily stylized/edited promotional studio portrait of the owner in a suit, not authentic gallery material per the no-portrait-in-gallery rule; kept ONLY as a small avatar in the Experience/owner chip, not a gallery tile). bk-2, bk-4 through bk-16 (excluding 1 and 3) are all tiny 100x100/150x150 Booksy review-attachment thumbnails (customer selfies, a kid's haircut, a skin-texture close-up, two SMS screenshots in Spanish): too small and/or off-brand, none used. Instagram set (bk-20..31): 5 of 12 are the owner's personal travel/life photos with zero shop connection (bk-21 Santiago de Compostela selfie, bk-22 hilltop with PR flag, bk-23 restaurant birthday cake, bk-25 horseback riding, bk-28 theme park, bk-31 NYC waterfront, bk-20/bk-27 a client's wedding photos) and were excluded per the 'never fabricate/never use unrelated personal content' curation rule; bk-24 is an excellent finished-fade shop photo but had a baked-in 'MEGA TRANSFORMATION!' caption overlay covering the bottom ~27%, so it was cropped (not retouched/altered otherwise) to remove the text band before use. That leaves 5 real, on-brand, caption-free, non-portrait usable photos: bk-1, bk-24 (cropped), bk-26, bk-29, bk-30, all genuine finished-haircut/shop-interior shots. Per PIPELINE.md ('si quedan menos de 5 buenas, usa menos secciones en vez de rellenar con malas'), the gallery uses exactly these 5 real photos (1 wide hero/gallery reuse + 4 tiles) instead of padding with off-topic personal photos.
